title: JazzArchiveCaptureCommit
description: Transport-neutral closure proof for one capture revision. The same object may be stored in an archive or sent over the live record stream.

firstSequence.description: First committed sequence in this stream. It is the minimum sequence covered by either an observation or an explicit gap, so it may precede the first retained observation.

lastSequence.description: Last committed sequence in this stream. It is the maximum sequence covered by either an observation or an explicit gap, so it may follow the last retained observation.

observationCount.description: Number of retained observation records in the committed range; explicitly gapped sequences are not observations.

orderedObservationDigest.description: SHA-256 of UTF-8 lines '<streamId>:<streamSequence>:<observationId>:<sha256(JCS(record))>\n', ordered by streamId then streamSequence. JCS is RFC 8785.

artifactSetDigest.description: SHA-256 of UTF-8 lines '<artifactId>:<content.sha256>\n', ordered by artifactId; the empty set hashes empty bytes.

gaps.description: Every sequence in a committed first/last range is covered exactly once by either a retained observation or an inclusive gap interval. Gaps may therefore precede the first retained observation or follow the last retained observation. An empty array is an explicit no-gap claim.
